description: Poll an audio project until it completes, errors, is canceled, or times out. After a timeout, resume with the same id; do not create another generation. Returns the final project JSON and, when complete, attempts to inline audio downloads for Inspector or compatible clients. Returns sanitized download fields. Use `exact_download_urls[n]` or `downloads[n].url` exactly as returned; do not shorten it, remove query parameters, or append expiration metadata. Inline previews share an 8 MiB limit; all download URLs remain available.
name: wait_for_audio_project
title: Wait for Audio Project
